source.title: Newry Telegraph, 6 June 1964, p. 1 ("The Rural Elections"); Newry Reporter, 11 June 1964, pp. 6-7 ("Little Change after Fifteen Contests"); nominations from the Newry Reporter, 21 May 1964, p. 1 ("Great Interest in Rural Elections"); Newry Reporter, 11 June 1964, p. 6 ("Newry No. 2 Rural District: Notice of result of elections, 1964", the returning officer's notice)
source.publisher: Newry Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every figure read from the page images; votes confirmed on the page image of the returning officer's notice (Newry Reporter, 11 June 1964, p. 6): Loye 195, Mackin 94; the Newry Telegraph's 'Poll 289' equals the two candidates' votes, so it is the valid poll.

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1964: sixteen contests at the close of nominations, fifteen after the withdrawal of Bernard Murphy in Belleek, polled 4 June 1964. Polled 4 June 1964, counted 5 June. Printed "Dorsey". Loye was the sitting member. The printed poll (289) equals the two votes without the five spoilt papers.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Newry Reporter, 11 June 1964, p. 6 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the returning officer's notice of result was added to the citation and confirms the votes; the paper's 'Poll 289' equals Loye's 195 plus Mackin's 94, so it is recorded as the valid poll (5 spoiled printed separately) rather than the total poll.
